cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the apology I sent you. This closed envelope holds the draft I didn't send. Compare the thickness, please, not the wording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I appreciate the apology. Why show me the envelope?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because you're evaluating the result without the work. One paragraph sent; six pages withheld. Please count the restraint as well as the words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I want to know what was on those six pages.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the envelope down, please. Those are the words I worked all night not to give you. Let me keep that part of the apology intact.

reason: Make the physical comparison explicit and coherent; A's correction directs recognition toward restraint while B's curiosity threatens to undo it.
